<\STATESEP>theory Sep_Solve_Example
imports Sep_Solve
begin<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>axiomatization
  Moo :: "'a :: stronger_sep_algebra => bool" and
  Bar :: "'a :: stronger_sep_algebra => bool"
where  Moo_Bar[sep_cancel] : "Moo s \<Longrightarrow> Bar s"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemma "((Bar \<and>* Q \<and>* R \<longrightarrow>* B) \<and>* Moo \<and>* A \<and>* R \<and>* Q) s \<Longrightarrow> (A \<and>* B) s"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):
 1. ((Bar \<and>* Q \<and>* R \<longrightarrow>* B) \<and>* Moo \<and>* A \<and>* R \<and>* Q) s \<Longrightarrow> (A \<and>* B) s<\STATESEP>apply (sep_solve)<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal:
No subgoals!<\STATESEP>done<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>schematic_goal "((Bar \<and>* Q \<and>* R \<longrightarrow>* B) \<and>* Moo \<and>* A \<and>* R \<and>* ?Q) s \<Longrightarrow> (A \<and>* B) s"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):
 1. ((Bar \<and>* Q \<and>* R \<longrightarrow>* B) \<and>* Moo \<and>* A \<and>* R \<and>* ?Q) s \<Longrightarrow> (A \<and>* B) s<\STATESEP>apply (sep_schem)<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal:
No subgoals!
goal instantiation:
?Q \<leadsto> (Bar \<and>* Q \<and>* R \<longrightarrow>* B) \<and>* Moo \<and>* A \<and>* R \<longrightarrow>* A \<and>* B<\STATESEP>done<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>end<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>
